cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Salesforce Administrator with 1-2 years of experience and basic knowledge of Copado to join our team. The role focuses on supporting and enhancing our Salesforce platform, with some involvement in release management using Copado.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Salesforce Configuration: Perform day-to-day Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, profiles, roles, permissions sets, workflows, and process automation using Process Builder and Flow.
Data Management: Manage data quality, imports, exports, and data cleansing activities to ensure data integrity and accuracy within the Salesforce platform.
User Support and Training: Provide support to Salesforce users, troubleshoot issues, and deliver training sessions to new users on Salesforce functionality and best practices.
Copado: Utilize Copado for end-to-end release management tasks, including creating and managing branches, performing deployments, and resolving deployment-related issues under guidance.
Documentation: Maintain up-to-date documentation of Salesforce configurations, processes, and procedures to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing within the team.
Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and other administrators, to gather requirements and implement solutions aligned with business needs.
Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for process improvement and automation within the Salesforce platform, GIT and Copado usage to enhance efficiency and productivity.
Branching and Merging: Define branching and merging strategies tailored to project requirements, including feature branches, release branches, and hotfix branches.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
1-2 Years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator.
Basic understanding of Copado and experience with basic release management tasks, such as branch creation, deployment, and conflict resolution.
Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, including creating custom objects, fields, page layouts, and workflows.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Preferred Requirements
Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) and Copado Certifications.
Familiarity with other Salesforce ecosystem tools and technologies, such as Salesforce Lightning, Process Builder, and Flow.
Previous exposure to basic Apex and Visualforce development concepts.
Knowledge of data management best practices, including data modelling and data migration tools.
Self-motivated with a strong desire to learn and grow in the Salesforce ecosystem.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0043.intro: We are looking for a Salesforce Administrator with 1-2 years of experience and basic knowledge of Copado to join our team. The role focuses on supporting and maintaining the Salesforce platform, with some involvement in release management tasks using Copado. It suits someone who works independently, pays attention to detail, and wants to build deeper expertise in Salesforce administration.
cond_0043.responsibilities:
Salesforce Configuration: Perform Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, profiles, roles, permission sets, workflows, and process automation using Process Builder and Flow.
Data Management: Manage data quality, imports, exports, and data cleansing activities to maintain data integrity and accuracy within the Salesforce platform.
User Support and Training: Troubleshoot issues reported by Salesforce users and deliver training to new users on Salesforce functionality and best practices.
Copado: Use Copado for release management tasks, including creating and managing branches, performing deployments, and resolving deployment-related issues under guidance.
Documentation: Keep documentation of Salesforce configurations, processes, and procedures up to date to support knowledge transfer within the team.
Coordination: Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and other administrators, to gather requirements and implement solutions aligned with business needs.
Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for process improvement and automation within the Salesforce platform, GIT, and Copado usage to improve efficiency and productivity.
Branching and Merging: Define branching and merging strategies suited to project requirements, including feature branches, release branches, and hotfix branches.
cond_0043.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
1-2 Years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator.
Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, including custom objects, fields, page layouts, and workflows.
Basic understanding of Copado and experience with release management tasks such as branch creation, deployment, and conflict resolution.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Clear written communication and direct verbal reporting when coordinating with stakeholders.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Preferred Requirements
Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) and Copado Certifications.
Familiarity with other Salesforce ecosystem tools such as Salesforce Lightning, Process Builder, and Flow.
Previous exposure to basic Apex and Visualforce development concepts.
Knowledge of data management best practices, including data modelling and data migration tools.
Self-motivated with a desire to build expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem.

cond_0053.intro: We are looking for a Salesforce Administrator with 1-2 years of experience and basic knowledge of Copado to join our team. In this role, you will own the day-to-day administration and enhancement of our Salesforce platform, with a focus on executing release management tasks using Copado. This is a solid opportunity for someone looking to grow their career in Salesforce administration and build hands-on Copado experience.
cond_0053.responsibilities:
Salesforce Configuration: Execute day-to-day Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, profiles, roles, permissions sets, workflows, and process automation using Process Builder and Flow.
Data Management: Own data quality, imports, exports, and data cleansing activities to ensure data integrity and accuracy within the Salesforce platform.
User Support and Training: Deliver support to Salesforce users, resolve issues, and lead training sessions for new users on Salesforce functionality and best practices.
Copado: Drive end-to-end release management tasks using Copado, including creating and managing branches, executing deployments, and resolving deployment-related issues under guidance.
Documentation: Maintain up-to-date documentation of Salesforce configurations, processes, and procedures to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing within the team.
Collaboration: Engage cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and other administrators, to gather requirements and implement solutions aligned with business needs.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and act on areas for process improvement and automation within the Salesforce platform, GIT and Copado usage to enhance efficiency and productivity.

cond_0053.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
1-2 Years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator, preferably in a fast-paced environment.
Basic understanding of Copado and experience with basic release management tasks, such as branch creation, deployment, and conflict resolution.
Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) and Copado Certifications will be plus but not required.
Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, including creating custom objects, fields, page layouts, and workflows.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
Self-motivated with a strong desire to learn and grow in the Salesforce ecosystem.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Familiarity with other Salesforce ecosystem tools and technologies, such as Salesforce Lightning, Process Builder, and Flow.
Previous exposure to basic Apex and Visualforce development concepts.
Knowledge of data management best practices, including data modelling and data migration tools.

This is a good opportunity for a self-starter looking to grow in Salesforce administration and gain exposure to Copado. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp how Salesforce configuration and release management fit together.
cond_0085.responsibilities:
Salesforce Configuration: Perform day-to-day Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, profiles, roles, permissions sets, workflows, and process automation using Process Builder and Flow.
Data Management: Manage data quality, imports, exports, and data cleansing activities to ensure data integrity and accuracy within the Salesforce platform.
User Support and Training: Provide support to Salesforce users, troubleshoot issues, and deliver training sessions to new users on Salesforce functionality and best practices.
Copado: Utilize Copado for end-to-end release management tasks, including creating and managing branches, performing deployments, and resolving deployment-related issues under guidance.
Documentation: Maintain up-to-date documentation of Salesforce configurations, processes, and procedures to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing within the team.
Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and other administrators, to gather requirements and implement solutions aligned with business needs.
Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for process improvement and automation within the Salesforce platform, GIT and Copado usage to enhance efficiency and productivity.
Branching and Merging: Define branching and merging strategies tailored to project requirements, including feature branches, release branches, and hotfix branches.
cond_0085.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
1-2 Years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator.
Basic understanding of Copado and experience with basic release management tasks, such as branch creation, deployment, and conflict resolution.
Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) and Copado Certifications will be plus but not required.
Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, including creating custom objects, fields, page layouts, and workflows.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
Self-motivated with a strong desire to learn and grow in the Salesforce ecosystem.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Familiarity with other Salesforce ecosystem tools and technologies, such as Salesforce Lightning, Process Builder, and Flow.
Previous exposure to basic Apex and Visualforce development concepts.
Knowledge of data management best practices, including data modelling and data migration tools.
cond_0085.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0085.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.
cond_0085.workplace_support: We work to create an environment where employees feel supported, heard, and able to do their best work. Our approach includes flexibility, trust, and practical support that helps people thrive across changing needs and responsibilities.

cond_0130.intro: We are seeking an individual with 1-2 years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator and basic knowledge of Copado to join our team. As a Salesforce Administrator, you will support and enhance our Salesforce platform, with a focus on using Copado for basic release management tasks. This is a good opportunity for a self-starter looking to grow their career in Salesforce administration and gain exposure to Copado. People who do well in this role are often quick to get a feel for how Salesforce configuration and release management fit together.
cond_0130.responsibilities:
Salesforce Configuration: Perform day-to-day Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, profiles, roles, permissions sets, workflows, and process automation using Process Builder and Flow.
Data Management: Manage data quality, imports, exports, and data cleansing activities to ensure data integrity and accuracy within the Salesforce platform.
User Support and Training: Provide support to Salesforce users, troubleshoot issues, and deliver training sessions to new users on Salesforce functionality and best practices.
Copado: Utilize Copado for end-to-end release management tasks, including creating and managing branches, performing deployments, and resolving deployment-related issues under guidance.
Documentation: Maintain up-to-date documentation of Salesforce configurations, processes, and procedures to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing within the team.
Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and other administrators, to gather requirements and implement solutions aligned with business needs.
Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for process improvement and automation within the Salesforce platform, GIT and Copado usage to enhance efficiency and productivity.
Branching and Merging: Define branching and merging strategies tailored to project requirements, including feature branches, release branches, and hotfix branches.
cond_0130.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
1-2 Years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator.
Basic understanding of Copado and experience with basic release management tasks, such as branch creation, deployment, and conflict resolution.
Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, including creating custom objects, fields, page layouts, and workflows.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
Self-motivated with a strong desire to learn and grow in the Salesforce ecosystem.
Preferred Requirements
Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) and Copado Certifications.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Familiarity with other Salesforce ecosystem tools and technologies, such as Salesforce Lightning, Process Builder, and Flow.
Previous exposure to basic Apex and Visualforce development concepts.
Knowledge of data management best practices, including data modelling and data migration tools.

cond_0163.intro: We are looking for a Salesforce Administrator with 1-2 years of experience and basic knowledge of Copado to join our team. The role focuses on supporting and enhancing our Salesforce platform, with some involvement in release management using Copado.
cond_0163.responsibilities:
Salesforce Configuration: Perform day-to-day Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, profiles, roles, permissions sets, workflows, and process automation using Process Builder and Flow.
Data Management: Manage data quality, imports, exports, and data cleansing activities to ensure data integrity and accuracy within the Salesforce platform.
User Support and Training: Provide support to Salesforce users, troubleshoot issues, and deliver training sessions to new users on Salesforce functionality and best practices.
Copado: Utilize Copado for end-to-end release management tasks, including creating and managing branches, performing deployments, and resolving deployment-related issues under guidance.
Documentation: Maintain up-to-date documentation of Salesforce configurations, processes, and procedures to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing within the team.
Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and other administrators, to gather requirements and implement solutions aligned with business needs.
Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for process improvement and automation within the Salesforce platform, GIT and Copado usage to enhance efficiency and productivity.
Branching and Merging: Define branching and merging strategies tailored to project requirements, including feature branches, release branches, and hotfix branches.
cond_0163.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
1-2 Years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator.
Basic understanding of Copado and experience with basic release management tasks, such as branch creation, deployment, and conflict resolution.
Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, including creating custom objects, fields, page layouts, and workflows.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Preferred Requirements
Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) and Copado Certifications.
Familiarity with other Salesforce ecosystem tools and technologies, such as Salesforce Lightning, Process Builder, and Flow.
Previous exposure to basic Apex and Visualforce development concepts.
Knowledge of data management best practices, including data modelling and data migration tools.
Self-motivated with a strong desire to learn and grow in the Salesforce ecosystem.

cond_0263.intro: We are looking for a Salesforce Administrator to join our team.
cond_0263.responsibilities:
Salesforce Configuration: Perform day-to-day Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, profiles, roles, permissions sets, workflows, and process automation using Process Builder and Flow.
Data Management: Manage data quality, imports, exports, and data cleansing activities to ensure data integrity and accuracy within the Salesforce platform.
User Support and Training: Provide support to Salesforce users, troubleshoot issues, and deliver training sessions to new users on Salesforce functionality and best practices.
Copado: Utilize Copado for end-to-end release management tasks, including creating and managing branches, performing deployments, and resolving deployment-related issues under guidance.
Documentation: Maintain up-to-date documentation of Salesforce configurations, processes, and procedures to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing within the team.
Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and other administrators, to gather requirements and implement solutions aligned with business needs.
Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for process improvement and automation within the Salesforce platform, GIT and Copado usage to enhance efficiency and productivity.
Branching and Merging: Define branching and merging strategies tailored to project requirements, including feature branches, release branches, and hotfix branches.
cond_0263.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise as a Salesforce Administrator.
Solid understanding of Copado and proven proficiency in release management tasks, such as branch creation, deployment, and conflict resolution.
Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) and Copado Certifications are strongly preferred.
Deep knowledge of Salesforce configuration, including creating custom objects, fields, page layouts, and workflows.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
Strong self-direction and a demonstrated commitment to continued growth within the Salesforce ecosystem.
Substantial experience working in an Agile development environment.
Proficiency in Salesforce ecosystem tools and technologies, such as Salesforce Lightning, Process Builder, and Flow.
Solid understanding of Apex and Visualforce development concepts.
Advanced knowledge of data management best practices, including data modelling and data migration tools.

cond_0395.intro: We are looking for a Salesforce Administrator with 1-2 years of experience and basic knowledge of Copado to join our team. In this role, you will own the day-to-day administration and enhancement of our Salesforce platform, with a focus on executing release management tasks using Copado. This is a solid opportunity for someone looking to grow their career in Salesforce administration and build hands-on Copado experience.
cond_0395.responsibilities:
Salesforce Configuration: Execute day-to-day Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, profiles, roles, permissions sets, workflows, and process automation using Process Builder and Flow.
Data Management: Own data quality, imports, exports, and data cleansing activities to ensure data integrity and accuracy within the Salesforce platform.
User Support and Training: Deliver support to Salesforce users, resolve issues, and lead training sessions for new users on Salesforce functionality and best practices.
Copado: Drive end-to-end release management tasks using Copado, including creating and managing branches, executing deployments, and resolving deployment-related issues under guidance.
Documentation: Maintain up-to-date documentation of Salesforce configurations, processes, and procedures to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing within the team.
Collaboration: Engage cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and other administrators, to gather requirements and implement solutions aligned with business needs.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and act on areas for process improvement and automation within the Salesforce platform, GIT and Copado usage to enhance efficiency and productivity.
Branching and Merging: Define branching and merging strategies tailored to project requirements, including feature branches, release branches, and hotfix branches.
cond_0395.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
1-2 Years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator, preferably in a fast-paced environment.
Basic understanding of Copado and experience with basic release management tasks, such as branch creation, deployment, and conflict resolution.
Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) and Copado Certifications will be plus but not required.
Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, including creating custom objects, fields, page layouts, and workflows.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
Self-motivated with a strong desire to learn and grow in the Salesforce ecosystem.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Familiarity with other Salesforce ecosystem tools and technologies, such as Salesforce Lightning, Process Builder, and Flow.
Previous exposure to basic Apex and Visualforce development concepts.
Knowledge of data management best practices, including data modelling and data migration tools.
cond_0395.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

This is a good opportunity for a self-starter looking to grow their career in Salesforce administration and gain exposure to Copado. People who do well in this role are often quick to get a feel for how Salesforce configuration and release management fit together.
cond_0544.responsibilities:
Salesforce Configuration: Perform day-to-day Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, profiles, roles, permissions sets, workflows, and process automation using Process Builder and Flow.
Data Management: Manage data quality, imports, exports, and data cleansing activities to ensure data integrity and accuracy within the Salesforce platform.
User Support and Training: Provide support to Salesforce users, troubleshoot issues, and deliver training sessions to new users on Salesforce functionality and best practices.
Copado: Utilize Copado for end-to-end release management tasks, including creating and managing branches, performing deployments, and resolving deployment-related issues under guidance.
Documentation: Maintain up-to-date documentation of Salesforce configurations, processes, and procedures to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing within the team.
Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and other administrators, to gather requirements and implement solutions aligned with business needs.
Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for process improvement and automation within the Salesforce platform, GIT and Copado usage to enhance efficiency and productivity.
Branching and Merging: Define branching and merging strategies tailored to project requirements, including feature branches, release branches, and hotfix branches.
cond_0544.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
1-2 Years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator.
Basic understanding of Copado and experience with basic release management tasks, such as branch creation, deployment, and conflict resolution.
Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, including creating custom objects, fields, page layouts, and workflows.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
Self-motivated with a strong desire to learn and grow in the Salesforce ecosystem.
Preferred Requirements
Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) and Copado Certifications.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Familiarity with other Salesforce ecosystem tools and technologies, such as Salesforce Lightning, Process Builder, and Flow.
Previous exposure to basic Apex and Visualforce development concepts.
Knowledge of data management best practices, including data modelling and data migration tools.
cond_0544.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
